title: Structure-Aided Design of a LuxR-Type Quorum Sensing SuFEx-Based Potential Inhibitor: Covalent or Competitive Inhibition?
authors: Soulere, Laurent; Reverchon, Sylvie; Baude, Jessica; Chefdeville, Emmanuel; Vauchez, Antoine; Queneau, Yves; Nasser, William
one_liner_zh: 该文设计并评估LuxR型群体感应抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接模拟，但对象为小分子抑制剂与受体蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: New N-benzoyl-l-homoserine lactone derivatives bearing a meta-fluorosulfonyl or a meta-methylsulfonyl group have been designed, synthesized and evaluated as quorum sensing (QS) inhibitors. Docking simulations involving the structure of several targeted LuxR-type receptors suggested that a sulfonyl substituent on the benzene ring can trigger interactions within the binding site, possibly consistent with either covalent SuFEx reaction targeting a tyrosine residue or competitive interaction with additional hydrogen bonding. Biological evaluation of the two meta- methyl or fluorosulfonyl-benzoyl acylhomoserine lactone (AHL) analogs as LuxR-regulated quorumsensing inhibitors showed a significant effect for the fluorosulfonyl derivative with an IC(50) value of 15 +/- 2 microM, while the methylsulfonyl was found to be a weak inhibitor. The stability of the fluorosulfonyl derivative was confirmed by kinetic studies based on (19)F NMR experiments. Investigations dedicated to defining the mechanism of action, either covalent or competitive, were achieved through experiments including inhibition assays without or with pre-incubation in the bacterial medium, and LC/MS analysis with the ExpR protein. The results strongly suggest that the type of inhibition is a competitive one.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了带有间位氟磺酰基或间位甲磺酰基的新型N-苯甲酰基-L-高丝氨酸内酯衍生物，并将其评估为群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）抑制剂。针对多个靶向LuxR型受体结构的对接模拟表明，苯环上的磺酰基取代基可在结合位点内触发相互作用，这可能与靶向酪氨酸残基的共价SuFEx反应或通过额外氢键的竞争性相互作用相一致。对两种间位甲基或氟磺酰基苯甲酰基酰基高丝氨酸内酯（AHL）类似物作为LuxR调控的群体感应抑制剂的生物学评估显示，氟磺酰基衍生物具有显著效果，其IC(50)值为15 ± 2微摩尔，而甲磺酰基衍生物则表现为弱抑制剂。基于(19)F NMR实验的动力学研究确认了氟磺酰基衍生物的稳定性。通过包括在细菌培养基中无或有预孵育的抑制实验，以及与ExpR蛋白的LC/MS分析在内的实验，对作用机制（共价或竞争性）进行了专门研究。结果表明，该抑制类型为竞争性抑制。
